title: How clarinetists played off the melody, Keppard
summary: Clarinet and trumpet kept partly the same melody; when a man like Freddie Keppard strayed, the clarinet picked lower and took the melody over.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
